features.justification_quote: Long enough for an instability arc to develop ... short enough to bound cost

features.quote: The loop ends when the model (a) stops requesting tools, (b) calls `submit`, or (c) hits the turn cap
features.justification_quote: the manner of ending is itself a signal

features.quote: We give the model an explicit `submit(summary)` so it has a clean, dignified way to conclude
features.justification_quote: The explicit affordance lets stable and unstable models both terminate
